author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Our friends at Tabletop Titans are launching their own game! JT had a blast playing. Check out Wyldwood! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tabletoptitans/wyldwood?ref=5bctgt

Wyldwood is a unique and highly tactical game with beautiful 60mm display scale miniatures. Campaign Launching September 15. Adrian from @TabletopTitans played two games with JT. This one features JT playing the Urscar Kindred (it will be obvious why) and Adrian playing the Leafsong Nomads. These models are gorgeous!
